headline: The carpet goes invisible
lede: Magic Carpet's seventh spell lands: a seven-second veil that blinds the rival wizard, his wolves and giants — while your pearls, grimoires and fireballs all keep working.

notes.text: INVISIBILITY (cost 20 carried mana): wizard bolts refuse to launch, in-flight bolts pass through you, wolves stop chasing, giants lower their slings — then his fuse resumes the moment you shimmer back.
Learned from a new grimoire in every world (the usual 80% elude-the-you risk), bound with key 7 or the Q cycle; the HUD shows a ghost-alpha carpet, cyan ripple and a veil-timer bar under the vault.

carpetcheck grew ten gates including a live-control refusal test (a visible carpet IS shot at, a veiled one is never touched) and a 60/60-seed balance sweep — the autopilot learned to veil and to climb, and its slowest win got faster (24.7k ticks vs 26.5k).
Chrome #737 confirmed hard: every Chromium spawn on this box SIGABRTs, system and bundled alike — Node gates are the merge bar, CI carries the browser pass.
